extension.summary: Low-power mode while this box is not the CEC active source
extension.description: Passively watches the HDMI-CEC bus. When another source is displayed (or the TV is on its own screen or in standby) and Kodi is idle and not playing, it activates the screensaver, lowers the CPU clock, turns off the board LEDs and optionally disables Ethernet. Everything is restored the moment this box is selected again, playback starts, or a key is pressed.
